entities.summary: Paolo Alesandro Espino Alonso is a Panamanian former professional baseball pitcher. He played parts of six seasons in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Milwaukee Brewers, Texas Rangers, Washington Nationals, and Toronto Blue Jays from 2017 to 2024.
